category_name: Portable Fire Extinguishers (ABC Dry Powder & CO2)
mandatory_certification: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) under Fire Fighting Equipment QCO

golden_parameters.extinguishing_media: Mono Ammonium Phosphate (MAP 50% or MAP 90%) conforming to IS 4308
golden_parameters.corrosion_resistance: 480 hours salt spray test as per IS 9844

critical_procurement_clauses: Extinguisher cylinder and extinguishing powder must be BIS ISI marked conforming to IS 15683:2018 and IS 4308.
Internal lining must be thermoplastic polymer / epoxy powder coated.
